VoiceCLAP Voice Cluster Demo

How two embedding models organize 100,000 voice samples into distinct vocal archetypes

How these clusters were made

100k audio samples were randomly drawn from 20 shards of laion/emolia-balanced-5M-subset (Emilia speech corpus). Each sample was embedded with VoiceNet/voiceclap-small (768-d, 110M params) and VoiceNet/voiceclap-large (3584-d, 7B params, Qwen2.5-Omni backbone), then clustered into 100 groups via GPU K-Means. The 6 most distinctive clusters per model were selected and captioned by Gemini 3.1 Pro. Each card shows the 5 samples nearest to the cluster centroid.

Small VoiceCLAP-small

768-d · 110M params · 100 clusters · top 6

1

Emotionally raw, angst-ridden voices conveying deep sorrow, frustration, and tearful distress through a highly dramatic, theatrical delivery.

2

A fervent, gravelly male voice preaching with intense evangelical zeal, high energy, and a distinct Southern accent.

3

A gentle, breathy female voice weaves soothing, meditative narratives with a warm, hypnotic, and deeply relaxing cadence.

4

A high-pitched, bubbly female voice bursting with animated energy, youthful enthusiasm, and exaggerated comedic flair.

5

A mature, resonant British male voice delivers steady, classic narration with a rich, warm storytelling charm.

6

An energetic, fast-paced male voice with a slightly nasal, conversational tone perfect for informal podcasts and gaming commentary.

Large VoiceCLAP-large

3,584-d · 7B params · 100 clusters · top 6

1

A wildly energetic, chaotic voice marked by frantic shrieks, breathless laughter, and moments of unhinged comedic panic.

2

A gentle, conversational female voice characterized by soft, empathetic tones and a warm, slightly breathy texture.

3

A fiery, high-energy voice blending rhythmic preaching and aggressive spoken-word delivery with a commanding, intense edge.

4

An earnest, emotionally vulnerable voice sharing intimate personal narratives and supportive advice with gentle, reflective sincerity.

5

A mature, resonant British male voice delivers steady, reflective narration with a warm, slightly gravelly texture.

6

An earnest, articulate voice delivers persuasive talks with passionate conviction, engaging clarity, and a slightly breathy texture.
